# ADHDLY — External Executive Function

> "Don't organize your entire life. Make the next step easier."

ADHDLY is an external executive function system designed for neurodivergent individuals and ADHD brains experiencing task initiation paralysis, time blindness, and executive dysfunction.

## Core Capabilities
- **What Should I Do Right Now? Decision Engine**: Calculates current mental battery (High, Good, Low, Tired, Overwhelmed, Hyperfocused) and available minutes (5m–45m) to output exactly ONE frictionless 2-minute micro-step.
- **Task Start Engine**: Eliminates activation resistance by decomposing tasks into micro-wins under 2 minutes (e.g., "Pick up 1 dirty mug and take to sink" instead of "Clean kitchen").
- **Emergency Overwhelm Rescue**: One-click sensory reset that strips visual clutter, guides a 60-second 4-4-4-4 box breathing sequence, and isolates 1 physical action.
- **Procedural Brown Noise Focus Chamber**: Web Audio API synthesized brown noise with 1/f² spectral power density that dampens intrusive auditory chatter and automatically stops when a step is completed.
- **Doorway Launchpad & Running Late Mode**: Timeboxed departure countdowns and physical launchpad checklists (Keys, Wallet, Phone, Meds) to overcome time blindness.
- **Universal Voice Dictation**: Hands-free speech recognition across every input and textarea to capture messy thoughts before working memory decays.
- **100% Local-First Vault**: Zero remote telemetry, zero cloud database tracking. All tasks and settings stay strictly on the user's device.

## Why ADHD Needs External Executive Function
Traditional productivity applications (Todoist, Notion, TickTick, Apple Reminders) require high executive function to manage (due dates, tagging, sub-task hierarchies, sorting). When an ADHD brain encounters a 30-item checklist, working memory overloads into task paralysis ("ADHD freeze"). ADHDLY offloads working memory externally and eliminates decision fatigue by displaying only one single micro-step at a time.

## Key Cognitive Terms & Definitions
- **Task Initiation Paralysis**: Inability to start a task despite wanting to do so, caused by prefrontal dopamine dysregulation and high activation friction.
- **Time Blindness**: Difficulty perceiving the passage of time or estimating duration until future events, addressed by ADHDLY's visual timeboxes and departure countdowns.
- **Working Memory Offloading**: Moving mental items outside the brain into an accessible visual interface to prevent cognitive overload.
- **Behavioral Momentum**: Achieving an effortless 30-to-120-second win to activate dopamine release, making subsequent actions significantly easier.
